DoorDash moved engineering agents to its Flux cloud platform.

Flux automated 130K engineering tasks in one month and now handles 25K+ automated code reviews weekly.

The platform uses Firecracker microVMs, MCP, reusable playbooks, and centralized auditing.

Learn more ⇨ https://www.infoq.com/news/2026/08/doordash-flux-cloud-agent/
